meta.title: Mythoria survey
meta.description: A short survey to help us shape Mythoria.

intro.estimatedMinutes: Less than {minutes} {minutes, plural, one {minute} other {minutes}} of your time
intro.resume: Pick up where you left off
intro.restored: We kept your earlier answers, so you can carry on where you stopped.
intro.privacy: Curious? You can learn how we handle your data in our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
intro.rewardBody: Complete this survey and you can choose a free gift for one of your published stories: a print-ready PDF or an audiobook, on us.

slider.numericLabel: Or type a number from {min} to {max}

errors.required: Please answer this question before moving on.
errors.invalid_kind: That answer doesn't look right. Please try again.
errors.unknown_option: Please pick one of the options listed.
errors.exclusive_conflict: That option can't be combined with the others.
errors.other_text_not_allowed: That extra text doesn't belong to the option you picked.
errors.too_long: That's a bit long. Please keep it under {max} characters.
errors.too_short: That's a bit short. Please write at least {min} characters.
errors.step_mismatch: Please enter a value in steps of {step}.
errors.duplicate_option: Each option can only be picked once.
errors.fixAnswers: Almost there. A few answers need another look.
errors.submitFailed: We couldn't send your answers just now. Nothing is lost, so please try again.
errors.closed: This survey has just closed, so we can't take new answers. Thank you for stopping by!

completion.title: Thank you!
completion.rewardEligible: Pick a free gift for one of your published stories. You'll need to sign in to your Mythoria account to choose it.
completion.rewardPending: Your gift is waiting for you. Once you publish your first story, you can sign in and claim it.

invalid.title: This link doesn't open a survey
invalid.body: The link may be incomplete or mistyped. Try opening it again from your email.

closed.title: This survey has closed
closed.body: We're not collecting answers any more, but we're grateful you stopped by. Every story needs a good ending, and this one's done.

submitted.title: You've already answered
submitted.body: Thank you, your answers are safely in. Each invitation can be answered once.

status.submittedReward: Your thank-you gift is still waiting. You'll need to sign in to choose it.
